items.title: Was Nvidia’s strong report a clearing event for the wider chip sector?
items.summary: Investing.com -- It’s too early to call the report a clearing event. As of 9:07 AM ET on Nov 18, 2026, the market is closed until 9:30 AM ET, so no regular-session reaction exists yet. The evidence so far is premarket and overseas trading, and it points to a relief bounce on top of unresolved problems.
